{{Quote|You know, a lot of the clones have taken up playing the trading card game, Card Commander. If you'd like to give it a shot, I'm sure we'll be able to find you a match! What do you say, boss?|Cards, to a prospective Card Commander player|<ref name="CWA" />}}
'''Cards''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="CWA" /> spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CWA" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CloneTrooper" /> [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="CWA" /> of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Cards was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from Fett's [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]], and as such, they stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="CloneTrooper" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Cards was an expert at the trading card game Card Commander,<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures: The Official Guide to the Virtual World]]''</ref> which was popular among [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the war. While stationed at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Cards held tournaments for the card game. Cards wore [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC trooper armor]], a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] with an extra ammunition pouch, and a [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']], all painted in the color black. Cards' [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] featured a side-mounted [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cards appeared as a non-player character in the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. Players can talk to Cards to access the "Card Commander" minigame. The armor Cards wears is available as a cosmetic option for players and is identified as "ARC Trooper General" armor. Despite the armor Cards wears being labeled as a [[General/Legends|general's]] armor, Cards is only ever referred to as holding the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of commander.<ref name="CWA" />
